youtube_description:
In April 2019, Baratunde delivered a talk at the TED conference (https://baratunde.com/livingwhileblack). He spoke about the phenomenon of white people calling the police on black people who are simply living their lives, and he made a case for a way to transform the stories of this trauma into something more beautiful.

As he left the stage, he was brought back on to answer one unexpected question. There was no warning or preparation for this.
youtube_title: Baratunde answers surprise question after his TED Talk
